topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture theme of cancer evolution and outlines the core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive fitness and drive Darwinian clonal selection.

topics.label: Tissue Hierarchy and the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue stem cell hierarchies and the differentiation state of the cell of origin influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how environmental promoters, inflammatory signals, and supportive stroma enable malignant outgrowth in incipient and established tumors.

topics.label: Methodologies for Studying Tumor Evolution and Spatial Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the single-cell sequencing and spatial transcriptomic and proteomic methods used to investigate tumor evolution and cell interactions.

topics.label: Multi-Factorial Synthesis of Cancer Evolution and Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics integrate the complementary roles of genetics, epigenetics, cell of origin, and microenvironment into a unified evolutionary model and conclude the lecture.
